mapper.select: SELECT o.id FROM pf.workspace_environment_operation o JOIN pf.workspace_environment e ON e.operation_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING') AND(o.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() OR o.deadline_at<=clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY o.created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_operation SET status='UNKNOWN',effect_state='MAY_HAVE_STARTED',error_code='ENVIRONMENT_OWNER_EXPIRED',version=version+1 WHERE id=#{operationId} AND status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING') AND(lease_until<=clock_timestamp() OR deadline_at<=clock_timestamp())
mapper.select: SELECT o.id FROM pf.workspace_environment e JOIN pf.workspace_environment_operation o ON o.id=e.operation_id WHERE e.state='READY' AND e.pending_operation_id IS NULL AND o.status='COMMITTED' AND o.kind IN('PREPARE','WAKE') ORDER BY e.last_activity_at LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_environment WHERE id=#{environmentId} AND state='READY' AND last_activity_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '60 seconds')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_operation WHERE space_id=#{spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND status IN('PENDING','CLAIMED','RUNNING','UNKNOWN'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.workspace_environment_operation(id,space_id,workspace_id,environment_id,kind,initiator,actor_id,command_id,generation,fence,status, protocol,lifecycle_intent,target_creation_command_id,target_creation_fence,target_image_id,target_policy_hash, target_project_id,target_container_id,target_container_started_at,cleanup_required,cleanup_state) SELECT #{operationId},#{previous.spaceId},#{previous.workspaceId},#{previous.environmentId},'STOP','SYSTEM',#{previous.actorId},#{commandId},#{previous.generation},#{fence},'PENDING', #{previous.protocol},CASE WHEN #{previous.protocol}='ENVIRONMENT_V3' THEN 'STOP' ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{previous.protocol}='ENVIRONMENT_V3' THEN e.creation_command_id ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{previous.protocol}='ENVIRONMENT_V3' THEN e.creation_fence ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{previous.protocol}='ENVIRONMENT_V3' THEN e.image_id ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{previous.protocol}='ENVIRONMENT_V3' THEN e.policy_hash ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{previous.protocol}='ENVIRONMENT_V3' THEN w.project_id ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{previous.protocol}='ENVIRONMENT_V3' THEN e.container_id ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{previous.protocol}='ENVIRONMENT_V3' THEN e.container_started_at ELSE NULL END, #{previous.protocol}='ENVIRONMENT_V3',CASE WHEN #{previous.protocol}='ENVIRONMENT_V3' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_REQUIRED' END FROM pf.workspace_environment e JOIN pf.workspace w ON w.space_id=e.space_id AND w.id=e.workspace_id WHERE e.id=#{previous.environmentId} AND e.space_id=#{previous.spaceId} AND e.workspace_id=#{previous.workspaceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_environment SET operation_id=#{operationId},fence=#{fence},version=version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() ,state=CASE WHEN #{previous.protocol}='ENVIRONMENT_V3' THEN 'STOPPING' ELSE state END WHERE id=#{previous.environmentId} AND space_id=#{previous.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{previous.workspaceId} AND generation=#{previous.generation} AND fence=#{currentFence} AND operation_id=#{previous.operationId} AND state='READY'
